critical_code_review_comments: Fix is clean and canonical. ReactDOM.createPortal to document.body is the correct pattern for full-screen modals inside RN-Web ScrollView hierarchies (which apply identity transforms and hijack position:fixed).
Defensive scrollTop reset in TravelVisaOnboarding.tsx useEffect is a good belt-and-suspenders safeguard; harmless even if portal handles the issue.
Minor: pre-onboarding /api/auth/me 401 (bootstrap) and one /api/... 403 during onboarding — pre-existing noise, not introduced by this fix (same as iter_910/911/912).

rca_of_the_issue: BUG2 RCA (confirmed resolved iter_913): Original bug — RN-Web ScrollView (tv-v2-root) applied identity transform: matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0), which per CSS spec establishes a new containing block for position:fixed descendants, causing the onboarding overlay to be dragged offscreen by outer scrollTop. FIX APPLIED (verified working): (a) The overlay is rendered via ReactDOM.createPortal(overlay, document.body) on web, escaping the transformed ancestor entirely; (b) TravelVisaOnboarding useEffect on currentStep also resets tv-v2-root.scrollTop=0 in setTimeout(0) as defense-in-depth. Verification: overlay.parentElement === document.body (portal working); level-beginner y=203 in viewport (visible); dashboard renders after Get Started.
